text:
You think you're self made. You're not.

Every man with real wealth had a small group behind him that made it possible. He just never talked about them.

A mastermind is simple: three to seven people who each bring real knowledge. You share it. You think harder together. You make better choices.

Your job isn't genius. Your job is getting in a room with people who know more than you.

Start today. Find one person who's good at something you're not. Meet them. Share a problem. Listen.

Alone you're smart. In a room you're unstoppable.
caption:
No man with real wealth built it alone. Discipline, focus, and success come from surrounding yourself with people who push you.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
